title: Bounded limited-auto mode: durable budgets, breakers, recovery probes, typed refusals (D-023 item 1)
objective: Implement the real bounded unattended mode with owner-controlled run budgets: NO hardcoded maximum run length anywhere (owner amendment D-023 source-002) - launch accepts an optional owner-supplied wall-clock budget including none/unlimited, and an unlimited run is never stopped by a timer; every owner-set budget (wall-clock when supplied, cycles/model-calls/external-writes/restarts/invalid-outputs/revision-loops/consecutive-no-progress) persists across crash-resume and can never be extended, reset, or shrunk by the run itself; every circuit breaker wired to actual production event sites; deterministic stop + safe deadline cleanup + explicit exit reason; cmd_start recovery revalidation replaced with live probes (task authority, branch/worktree, git/remote, auth/capabilities, pending requests, deadlines, external effects, config identity, surviving children) that stop on missing/ambiguous evidence; machine-meaningful typed nonzero refusal outcomes for halted/unsafe/unsupported/stale/approval-required; structured refusal replaces the limited-auto NotImplementedError traceback.
business_reason: D-023 Appendix-A item 1 (amended by source-002: run length owner-controlled, unlimited allowed) and packet must-fix 2/3/7/14: the mode must enforce owner-set budgets faithfully and be crash-honest before any activation evidence is possible.
